headline: Gambia Central Bank Directive Threatens Foreign Bank Workers
summary: A directive by the Central Bank of The Gambia requiring banks to replace non-Gambian employees with local workers by the end of 2026 has put 57 Nigerian professionals at risk.
why: Cross-border labor regulations and regional banking directives can affect staffing operations, operational costs, and diplomatic relations among West African nations.

impacts.name: Gambian Banking Sector
impacts.why: Mandated staffing changes impact workforce composition in the country's banks.
